body: Kill double-count fixed (removed +500 redundant reward); kill reduced 1000→150 for balance; per-damage reward +0.5/hp; CTF objectives scaled 5x (capture 500, pickup 80, carrier_kill 100); w_retreat genome gene (health-aware retreat <30% HP); w_repel activated as evasive strafe under fire; evolve_bot two-parent crossover with clamping; headed_policy_reinforce() on reward events; per-tick survival+engagement reward in training modes
title: AI reward system improvements — 6 fixes
